prompt.content: Solve only from the supplied problem. Return one JSON object with "answer" equal to a string 0, 1, 2, 3, or UNKNOWN if the facts do not determine a unique answer. You may add a short "state" string (at most 20 words). Do not use outside knowledge.

Check mechanical consistency independently. Build a compact table of intermediate states or earliest legal start times; check each transition, prerequisite, counterfactual deletion and latest-record rule. Recompute the answer. Also return boolean "candidate_valid".

PROBLEM
Four unit-duration jobs may run in parallel. Times begin at 0. A job starts only after all prerequisites finish. All listed dependencies are complete except any explicitly unrecorded row. The only possible prerequisites of each job are jobs earlier in this list. Find the earliest possible start under the actual dependencies.
Job netsxsp: prerequisites none.
Job nsqtqmy: prerequisites netsxsp.
Job njfhqrw: prerequisites nsqtqmy.
Job nsawrru: prerequisites netsxsp, njfhqrw.
What is the earliest start time of netsxsp?
